why: Feature indexes are generated from layer sources in test/source-cache/, which is gitignored. Only 80 indexes are tracked, so on any machine without those sources -- including the Cloudflare Pages deploy build -- these layers cannot be matched, and their elections are written with matchedCount 0 and loadable false. That is what is deployed today and has been for some time. Baselining keeps deploys working while making the debt countable; it is not an endorsement. The fix is to regenerate these indexes where the sources exist and commit them, deleting entries from this file as they land.
effect: A layer listed here warns. A layer not listed fails the build.
